6. With the remaining 1 gold ingot, I can now craft 2 stick.
7. Craft 1 golden hoe using 2 stick and 2 gold ingot.

5. Craft 18 gold nuggets into 2 gold ingots.
6. Craft 1 golden pickaxe using 2 stick and 3 gold ingot.
7. Craft 2 stick using 2 planks.
8. Craft 1 golden hoe using 2 stick and 2 gold ingot.

That completes the crafting of the golden hoe.
